# `third-party-registration`

**Page rule** · `warning` · on by default

A tool registered by a script from another origin is part of the page's agent surface but not of its source.

A page rule judges the tool surface as a whole, so it needs a full snapshot: the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler, or `lint()` over a snapshot you collected yourself. Static analysis of a single `registerTool()` call cannot run it.

## Options

| Option  | Default |
| ------- | ------- |
| `allow` | `[]`    |

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "third-party-registration": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "third-party-registration": "warning" } }); // change severity
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "third-party-registration": { allow: [] } } });
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule third-party-registration=off
```
